##3-3 point invasion White slips out of the severe attack by entering the corner. This possibility doesn't exist if Black first played a 3-4 point stone. (p. 62.)
is the most common continuation, especially in modern pro play.
was historically common but has become rare in modern pro play. It sees play when black already has stones on the top of the board that make influence in that area more valuable than influence on the side.
